## Checklist

- [ ] Acceptance criteria for the Task are met with **real** behaviour (no fake UI)
- [ ] Tests added or updated — **name the workflow test** that proves this Task:
      `src/…/___.test.ts › …` (smoke-only tests are rejected)
- [ ] CI is green (or will be after merge of required base)
- [ ] No unbounded local full builds used to "verify" on a constrained machine
- [ ] No proprietary source, assets, or RE material introduced
- [ ] Public research notes are original summaries + URLs only (if applicable)
- [ ] ROADMAP / CHANGELOG / parity updated if this completes a tracked item
- [ ] Secrets and tokens not committed
- [ ] User-facing strings and UI are original (no copied trade dress)
- [ ] New dependencies are within the allowed licence classes and recorded in `ATTRIBUTION.md`

## Accessibility (required for any user-visible change)

- [ ] Keyboard: every new control is reachable and operable by keyboard, with a visible focus indicator
- [ ] Focus order is logical; dialogs/drawers manage focus on open and close
- [ ] Controls are labelled; form errors are announced and programmatically associated
- [ ] Colour is never the only signal; contrast holds at WCAG AA
- [ ] Reduced-motion is respected; no flashing or auto-advancing content
- [ ] Touch targets are at least 24×24 CSS px
- [ ] Screen reader spot-checked (or say which check was not done)
- [ ] Reviewed by the `designer` subagent (rendered result, not just the diff)
